bind_notes: Riley currently has NO starting team anywhere in the project: protagonist_canon.json / protagonist_canon.gd define protagonist id 'riley' (identity, appearance, home kanto_pallet_riley_house, 6-ball rig) only, and no Riley team data exists in the mirror or the pack tree. The only starting-party mechanism in the game today is the single Lv5 starter choice (campaign/starters.json: Bulbasaur/Charmander/Squirtle) via CampaignFlow.choose_starter, which also refuses a second starter. Binding this team therefore needs a Riley-specific starting-party grant at bind time (his six records placed directly into his new-game party), not a starters.json edit.

CampaignFlow.build_starter builds IV 0 / EV 0 mons with no ability, nature, or held item. This record's extended fields carry the spec's builds; the binding lane must apply them (or extend the builder) rather than letting them drop.

Eviolite is real and implemented in the staged item work (code_prep_items and code_prep_items_hooks item_engine.gd: 1.5x Def/SpD while the holder can still evolve; also in the item registry and Showdown items data, num 538). It is held by slots 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, all unevolved, and works as specified on each. Slot 4 (Mimikyu) holds Mimikium Z instead, exactly as Riley specified - see the exception note on that slot.

Gimmick assignments in this record (Metagrossite, Mimikium Z + Play Rough, Appletun Gigantamax Factor, Heliolisk Dynamax, Tentacool Tera Type Flying) are ASSIGNED BUT GATED: per locked canon, gimmicks unlock per progression and NONE are available in Kanto. Held items stay as specified; usability follows the unlock canon. Tentacool's designated Tera Type (Flying) must be stored on the record and retained when it evolves into Tentacruel, per the spec's implementation notes.

ALL of these stay behind the locked per-progression gimmick-unlock canon - none are usable at a Kanto start. Nothing in the starting record depends on a gimmick being usable.
